column1: # The config differential test's record: the newest published build, the oracle copied from it,
# the core sources the oracle compiles, and the inputs. check-frozen.ps1 fails when a working-tree
# path below stops matching its hash. Rows naming <commit>:<path> are provenance, the blobs the
# oracle came from, and are not checked.
# Published builds: the rolling dev pre-release only, 0.0.0-nightly.20260820.234785c, built from
# 234785c at cameraunlock-core 3465659. There is no v* release. Its installer ZIP ships
# plugins/HeadTracking.ini and its launcher manifest seeds reframework/plugins/HeadTracking.ini,
# both byte for byte 234785c:HeadTracking.ini. The import is core's PluginConfigLegacyImport over
# PluginConfig::Read, which core keeps frozen and pins in its own tests; the differential test
# compiles it at the current pin on every run, so it is not recorded here.
